```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(matrixStats)
library(DESeq2)
library(biomaRt)
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
library(stats)
```

# loading data
```{r load_data}
load("tcga_tpm_list.TOIL_RSEM.20190228.RData")
clinical_dataset <- readRDS("TCGA_clinical/clinical_dataset.rds")

# clinical data
clinical_dataset$BMI <- clinical_dataset$weight / (clinical_dataset$height / 100)^2

clinical_dataset <- clinical_dataset |>
  mutate(
    bmi_groups = case_when(
      BMI < 18.5             ~ "Normal",
      BMI >= 18.5 & BMI < 25 ~ "Normal",
      BMI >= 25  & BMI < 30  ~ "Overweight",
      BMI >= 30              ~ "Obese",
      TRUE                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    bmi_groups = factor(bmi_groups, levels = c("Normal", "Overweight", "Obese")),
    age_cat    = if_else(age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis < 65, "young", "old"),
    age_cat    = factor(age_cat, levels = c("young", "old")),
    bmi_binary = ifelse(BMI >= 25, "HighBMI", "Normal"),
    bmi_binary = factor(bmi_binary, levels = c("Normal", "HighBMI"))
  ) |>
  distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

# annotation

```{r annotation}
ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", mirror = "useast")

genes <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name", "chromosome_name", "transcript_biotype"),
  filters    = c("transcript_biotype", "chromosome_name"),
  values     = list("protein_coding", c(1:22)),
  mart       = ensembl
)
genes <- genes[!duplicated(genes$ensembl_gene_id), ]
```

# genesets

```{r gene_sets}
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") %>% 
  split(x = .$ensembl_gene, f = .$gs_name)
```

# 

```{r functions}
# Filter to a single cancer type and return expression + clinical data
filter_cancertype <- function(cancer_type, drop_list) {
  clin_final <- clinical_dataset |>
    filter(`cancer type abbreviation` == cancer_type) |>
    drop_na(all_of(drop_list)) |>
    distinct(`_PATIENT`, .keep_all = TRUE)

  rna_matrix <- tcga_tpm_list[[cancer_type]]

  # Keep only expressed genes
  keep      <- rowSums(rna_matrix) > 0
  rna_matrix <- rna_matrix[keep, ]

  # Align samples
  common_ids <- intersect(clin_final$sample, colnames(rna_matrix))
  if (length(common_ids) < 10) {
    message("Too few samples for ", cancer_type, " — skipping")
    return(NULL)
  }
  expr_final <- rna_matrix[, common_ids]
  clin_final <- clin_final |>
    filter(sample %in% common_ids) |>
    arrange(match(sample, common_ids))

  # strip Ensembl version numbers
  gene_names        <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(expr_final))
  expr_final        <- round(apply(expr_final, 2, as.numeric))
  rownames(expr_final) <- gene_names

  # Keep only autosomal protein-coding genes
  expr_final <- expr_final[rownames(expr_final) %in% genes$ensembl_gene_id, ]

  # filtering expressed in ≥10% of samples
  keep_genes   <- rowSums(expr_final > 0.5) > (ncol(expr_final) * 0.10)
  expr_filtered <- expr_final[keep_genes, ]

  # top 2000 most variable genes (supervisor recommendation)
  gene_variability  <- rowSds(expr_filtered)
  top_idx           <- order(gene_variability, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(2000, nrow(expr_filtered))]
  expr_top_var      <- expr_filtered[top_idx, ]

  list(expr = expr_top_var, clin = clin_final)
}

# run Spearman correlation and return ranked data frame
run_spearman <- function(results, variable) {
  cor_results <- apply(results$expr, 1, function(gene_expr) {
    cor.test(gene_expr, variable, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  })
  rho  <- sapply(cor_results, function(x) unname(x$estimate))
  pval <- sapply(cor_results, function(x) x$p.value)

  data.frame(
    gene = names(rho),
    rho  = rho,
    pval = pval,
    padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")
  ) |> arrange(desc(abs(rho)))
}

# build ranked list for fgsea from correlation data frame
make_rankings <- function(cor_df) {
  r <- cor_df$rho
  names(r) <- cor_df$gene
  sort(r, decreasing = TRUE)
}
```

 output

```{r dirs}
dir.create("fgsea_spearman/rankings", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# bmi: Spearman fgsea across cancer

```{r bmi_loop}
cancer_types <- intersect(
  unique(clinical_dataset$`cancer type abbreviation`),
  names(tcga_tpm_list)
)

bmi_drop <- c("BMI")   # only need BMI to be non-missing

for (i in cancer_types) {
  tryCatch({
    message("BMI — Processing: ", i)

    results <- filter_cancertype(i, drop_list = bmi_drop)
    if (is.null(results)) next

    cor_df   <- run_spearman(results, results$clin$BMI)
    rankings <- make_rankings(cor_df)

    # Save rankings for diagnostic plots later
    saveRDS(rankings, paste0("fgsea_spearman/rankings/", i, "_rankings_BMI.rds"))

    gseares <- fgsea(
      pathways  = hallmark,
      stats     = rankings,
      scoreType = "std",
      minSize   = 10,
      maxSize   = 500,
      nproc     = 1
    )

    gseares_df             <- as.data.frame(gseares)
    gseares_df$cancer_type <- i   # attach label here for safety

    saveRDS(gseares_df, paste0("fgsea_spearman/", i, "_hallmark_BMI.rds"))
    message("BMI — Done: ", i)

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("BMI — Failed for: ", i, "\n  Error: ", e$message)
  })
}
```

# age: spearman fgsea across cancer types

```{r age_loop}
age_drop <- c("age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis")

for (i in cancer_types) {
  tryCatch({
    message("AGE — Processing: ", i)

    results <- filter_cancertype(i, drop_list = age_drop)
    if (is.null(results)) next

    cor_df   <- run_spearman(results, results$clin$age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis)
    rankings <- make_rankings(cor_df)

    # Save rankings for diagnostic plots later
    saveRDS(rankings, paste0("fgsea_spearman/rankings/", i, "_rankings_AGE.rds"))

    gseares <- fgsea(
      pathways  = hallmark,
      stats     = rankings,
      scoreType = "std",
      minSize   = 10,
      maxSize   = 500,
      nproc     = 1
    )

    gseares_df             <- as.data.frame(gseares)
    gseares_df$cancer_type <- i   # attach label here for safety

    saveRDS(gseares_df, paste0("fgsea_spearman/", i, "_hallmark_AGE.rds"))
    message("AGE — Done: ", i)

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("AGE — Failed for: ", i, "\n  Error: ", e$message)
  })
}
```

# results
```{r load_results}
# bmi
bmi_files      <- list.files("fgsea_spearman", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "_hallmark_BMI\\.rds$")
all_results_bmi <- lapply(bmi_files, function(f) {
  df             <- readRDS(f)
  # cancer_type already attached in loop, but strip filename as fallback
  if (!"cancer_type" %in% colnames(df))
    df$cancer_type <- sub("_hallmark_BMI\\.rds$", "", basename(f))
  df
}) |> bind_rows()

# age
age_files      <- list.files("fgsea_spearman", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "_hallmark_AGE\\.rds$")
all_results_age <- lapply(age_files, function(f) {
  df             <- readRDS(f)
  if (!"cancer_type" %in% colnames(df))
    df$cancer_type <- sub("_hallmark_AGE\\.rds$", "", basename(f))
  df
}) |> bind_rows()

saveRDS(all_results_bmi, "fgsea_spearman/all_results_BMI.rds")
saveRDS(all_results_age, "fgsea_spearman/all_results_AGE.rds")
```

# significant

```{r sig_results}
sig_bmi <- all_results_bmi |> filter(padj < 0.05)
sig_age <- all_results_age |> filter(padj < 0.05)

message("Significant BMI pathway-cancer combinations: ", nrow(sig_bmi))
message("Significant AGE pathway-cancer combinations: ", nrow(sig_age))
```

# NES heatmap age

```{r heatmap_age}
library(pheatmap)

nes_matrix_age <- all_results_age |>
  filter(padj < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::select(pathway, cancer_type, NES) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = cancer_type, values_from = NES, values_fill = 0)

mat_age      <- as.matrix(nes_matrix_age[, -1])
rownames(mat_age) <- nes_matrix_age$pathway
row_order    <- order(rowMeans(mat_age, na.rm = TRUE))
max_val      <- max(abs(mat_age), na.rm = TRUE)

pdf("heatmap_age.pdf")
pheatmap(
  mat_age[row_order, ],
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  treeheight_row = 0,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  color          = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
  breaks         = seq(-max_val, max_val, length.out = 101),
  main           = "Hallmark pathways NES (AGE)"
)
dev.off()
```

# Enrichment plots, Using these to check that enrichment signals are not driven by a single gene

```{r enrichment_plots}
library(ggplot2)

save_enrichment_plots <- function(all_results, variable, padj_cutoff = 0.05) {
  
  out_dir <- paste0("fgsea_spearman/enrichment_plots/", variable)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  cancer_types <- unique(all_results$cancer_type)
  
  for (ct in cancer_types) {
    
    # Load rankings for this cancer type
    rankings_file <- paste0("fgsea_spearman/rankings/", ct, "_rankings_", variable, ".rds")
    if (!file.exists(rankings_file)) {
      message("No rankings file for ", ct, " — skipping")
      next
    }
    rankings <- readRDS(rankings_file)
    
    # get significant pathways for this cancer type
    sig_pathways <- all_results |>
      filter(cancer_type == ct, padj < padj_cutoff) |>
      arrange(padj) |>
      pull(pathway)
    
    if (length(sig_pathways) == 0) {
      message("No significant pathways for ", ct, " — skipping")
      next
    }
    
    pdf_path <- paste0(out_dir, "/", ct, "_", variable, "_enrichment_plots.pdf")
    pdf(pdf_path, width = 8, height = 5)
    
    for (pw in sig_pathways) {
      if (!pw %in% names(hallmark)) next
      p <- plotEnrichment(hallmark[[pw]], rankings) +
        labs(
          title    = paste(ct, variable, sep = " | "),
          subtitle = pw
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 11)
      print(p)
    }
    
    dev.off()
    message("Saved: ", pdf_path)
  }
}

# Run for both variables
save_enrichment_plots(all_results_bmi, "BMI")
save_enrichment_plots(all_results_age, "AGE")
```
